text:
Aisha K: Placing a controlled switch for v2 on shard B tonight 21:00 UTC. Plan: 15m canary (internal keys) -> 10% for 30m -> 50% -> 100% over 2h if stable. Fallback to v1 remains enabled for first 90m.
Tom H: Confirming deploy-config: `deploy-configs/v2/shard-b-cutover.yaml` has the auto-rollback rule (error_rate > 3% over 5m).
Rina S: Added extra dashboard panel for `v2.request.4xx_by_tenant`. Will alert on unusual 4xx spikes.
Marco D: Noted: older web clients (client-lib <= 1.7.x) may send lowercase `x-client-version` and hit header normalization. I pushed a gateway shim to normalize header case.
Aisha K: Good call. We still want an opt-out list for tenants with pinned v1 behavior. DM me if you need to add a tenant.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Aisha K for 2026-03-21T21:00:00Z to eu-west-1 cluster. Steps: canary -> gradual-shift -> monitor -> finalize. Autorestore on critical SLO breach.
oncall-ops: I'll be watching 20:45-22:30 UTC. Add `v2.gateway.latency.p95.shard_b` to pager rules at 2x normal sensitivity.
Tom H: Cache question: will the K/V cache prefix change? We kept it `v2:shardB:` so entries persist. Confirm TTL preserved.
Rina S: TTLs unchanged. Also enabled short-term tracing sample increase for `/v2/` paths to 10% during the window.
Marco D: Runbook step: flip fallback command (ops only): `curl -X POST https://admin.internal/route/shardB/fallback?action=enable -H "Authorization: Bearer <ops-token>"`. Reverse with `action=disable`.
Aisha K: Canary keys routed now at 20:50 UTC — 25 internal keys. deploy-bot: applied canary.
deploy-bot: Canary traffic report: no errors, latency within baseline. Proceeding to 10% shift at 21:00 UTC.
oncall-ops: Observing canary traces, looks green. Proceeding. :thumbsup:
Tom H: Added temporary alert: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{route=~"/v2/.*",status=~"4.."}[5m])) > 8` -> page ops. Tied to runbook.
Marco D: If we see schema validation errors with code 422 spike, pause rollout and flip fallback.
Rina S: Product note: update release notes to include compat suggestion to set header `x-api-compat: v1` for older clients.
docs-team: Will add the compat blurb and a small troubleshooting section for header normalization.
Aisha K: After 60m healthy at 10% we ramp to 50%. If any tenant shows >2% increase in 5xx, we manual pause and investigate.
Tom H: I'm standing by for the operator handoff. I'll annotate the changelog with `#shard-b-v2-cutover` and include the watch timestamps.
Aisha K: Thanks all. If anyone wants to opt-out tenants now, DM me. We'll log everything in the deploy ticket.
